title: Crown Prince Hans-Adam's Armageddon agenda, 1994 meeting
summary: Steven Greer tells of Crown Prince Hans-Adam's Armageddon agenda, 1994 meeting, about 1994 at Pierre Hotel, New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: is that we want the public to hate the aliens so bad that we can have an interplanetary war so that we'll have Armageddon. So Christ will return. I'm quoting.

plain: A doctor and UFO campaigner named Steven Greer says that in 1994, at the Pierre Hotel in New York, he was at a meeting with Hans-Adam II, then crown prince of the small European country of Liechtenstein, alongside figures such as the wealthy backer Lawrence Rockefeller and alien-abduction researchers Budd Hopkins, John Mack and David Jacobs. Greer says the prince's aim, as he quotes it, was to make the public hate aliens so much that there could be an interplanetary war, bringing on Armageddon so that Christ would return. If true, it would mean powerful people were trying to steer public feeling about aliens toward a war for religious ends.
